title: Monthly Vehicle Permit Fee on the Community Rules & Site Care Statement: Desk Posting Card
content:
The monthly vehicle permit fee of a Community Rules & Site Care plan record is charged for each month in which the site carries more registered vehicles than its permit-free allowance, dated the plan fee due day of that month and referenced to that month as its billing period. The resident desk posts the fee to the plan record's rules and site-care statement.

## What the posting does

`post_vehicle_permit_fee_c6960799` adds one vehicle permit fee charge for one billing month to the statement of the named plan record, carrying the number of permits charged and the fee amount, and raises the record's statement balance by that amount. The resident sees the charge on their rules and site-care statement for that month.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool. The representative first unlocks `post_vehicle_permit_fee_c6960799` and then calls it, on the resident desk's behalf. One call posts the fee of one billing month.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rules_plan_id` | the reference number of the site-care plan record whose statement is charged, as returned by the site-care plan record lookup for the resident | identifier |
| `billing_period` | the calendar month the permit fee covers | YYYY-MM — four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month, for example 2026-03 |
| `entry_date` | the charge date shown on the statement for that month | YYYY-MM-DD — calendar date, no time of day, no time zone |
| `permit_count` | the number of registered vehicles charged a permit for the month | whole non-negative integer |
| `amount` | the permit fee for the month, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with status `posted`, showing the statement reference of the new charge, the plan record charged, the billing month, the charge date, the permit count, the amount, and the plan record's statement balance once the charge is on it. The tool defines no other outcome.

## Hypothetical illustration of the receipt

A plan record whose statement balance stood at $100.00 receives a posting with an amount of 30.00; the receipt shows status `posted` and a statement balance of $130.00.
